reviewContext.userProblem: Nodetto can import Gerber files and export breadboard boards to Gerber, but it cannot open a KiCad board (.kicad_pcb), represent it as circuit data, edit it in the desktop app, save it losslessly as Nodetto JSONL, or export Gerber and drill files from an edited board.
requiredOutcomes: Page kind 'pcb' and six element types pcb.board, pcb.footprint, pcb.track, pcb.via, pcb.zone, pcb.graphic with structural validation; units in mm, geometry in the semantic, PCB_PAGE_SCALE = 10 page units per mm (design 3; plan 01).

importKicadPcb reads KiCad 5 to 9 .kicad_pcb text into a PcbImportPlan with diagnostics; the self-authored two-layer fixture with footprints, pads, nets, tracks (incl. arc), vias, a zone and an Edge.Cuts outline imports with every item and net preserved (design 4, 11; plans 04, 09).

Moving or rotating a footprint keeps attached track ends on its pads for every move source, undoable in one step; tracks and vias can be added on a chosen layer and net; deleting a track shows the now-unrouted ratsnest line; net highlight and 'Select net' cover every item of a net; layer visibility is transient (design 5, 6; plans 05, 06, 09, 11, 12).
Saving and reopening gives an identical PCB page: serialize -> parse -> serialize is byte-equal and deep-equal, before and after edits (design 3.4; plan 09).

exportPcbBoard and encodePcbBoardZip produce GTL, GBL, GTS, GBS, GTO, optional GBO, GKO, DRL and optional -NPTH.DRL using only the packages/core/src/pcb writers (additive flashAperture, region, arc, nonPlated and slots); readGerber and readExcellon read them back with matching copper, holes and outline (1e-6 mm Gerber, 0.0005 mm Excellon) (design 7; plans 02, 07, 09).

nodetto-cli pcb import <file.kicad_pcb> [--output] [--strict] and pcb gerber <doc> --output <zip> [--page] [--strict] in the TS CLI, with a native parity case passing under mise run test-cli (design 8; plan 10).
Desktop: Open dialog accepts .kicad_pcb as a detached unsaved document; Export dialog PCB tab 'Gerber and drill (.zip)'; inspector PCB section (design 9; plans 12, 13).
docs/pcb/kicad-pcb.md, docs/cli.md block and one README bullet (design 10; plan 03).

constraints: Follow AGENTS.md: English only, no emojis, ASCII docs, cargo with CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true, strict TypeScript.
KiCad source in .reference/kicad is reference only; original implementation; no copied KiCad code or wording.
Only self-authored fixtures (test-fixtures/kicad/two-layer.kicad_pcb, kicad5.kicad_pcb); never commit third-party boards such as ErgoDash or derivatives.
No regex split and no quadratic parsing (Boa native CLI); single-pass child map per item; grid index for connectivity and follow.

Determinism for TS/native parity: arithmetic, Math.sqrt and pcbRotate only in geometry, export and follow code; no Math.hypot or atan2; deterministic ids and indexes; fixture rotations are multiples of 45.
Writer changes are additive; breadboard ZIP must stay byte-identical (plan 02 cmp) and export-golden.test.ts must pass unchanged.

Workers follow impl-plans/active/kicad-pcb-00-overview.md 'Per-worker protocol': sha256 before and after edits, intent snapshot, edit only writePaths and own progress log, no state-changing git, no workspace-wide formatter, foreground commands, no pipe into tee or head, sibling typecheck failures recorded and rerun, never counted as a pass.
Wave-2 plans import each other only through relative paths to earlier-wave modules; the @nodetto/core barrel is written once by plan 09.
designDecisionsAndRationale: PCB geometry lives in the semantic in mm, not in visual, because 0.01 visual rounding would lose KiCad's 1 nm resolution; no PCB keys in any coordinates list (design 3.4, 13).
Pad and text angles in the file are board-absolute; the reader stores rotation = fileAngle - footprintRotation; bottom-side local geometry is stored as read (design 4.3, 15).

Track-end follow is a derived planner in Editor.apply comparing before/draft stores, so drag, nudge, inspector, undo/redo and CLI edit all follow; tracks already changed in the batch are skipped (design 5.3; plan 05).
Own copper connectivity (union-find over a per-layer grid, same-net contacts only) and Prim ratsnest with deterministic tie-breaks; not shared with breadboard (design 5.5, 13; plan 06).

Export uses one frame mapping (gx = x - minX, gy = maxY - y) from the Edge.Cuts extent; text pipeline converts the y-up strokeText output to the board frame before justify, mirror, rotate, place (design 7.3; plans 07, 11 review KP-R3, KP-R4).
Drill positions stay at the unchanged writer's 0.001 mm resolution; no writer precision option (design 7.3, review DR-1).
Wave 3 exists so the pcb-board barrel and the core index line are written once by plan 09 after all wave-2 modules exist (overview).
Lossless JSONL test lives in core (plan 09), not packages/io, because io cannot import core (review L6).

User QA defaults Q1-Q5 are implemented: transient layer visibility, F.Cu/B.Cu only with an inner-layer warning, GBO and -NPTH.DRL only when needed, zone fills exported as read with a note, free track angles.
intentionalTradeoffs: Zone fills are not refilled after edits; stale fills are possible and are noted in the export notes (user QA Q4).
Inner copper layers are imported but not exported; a warning is emitted and --strict exits 3 (user QA Q2).
Silkscreen is not clipped against mask openings; text uses Nodetto's stroke font, so its shape differs from KiCad's (design 13).
Vias are always tented; pad mask openings use a grown pad shape (design 13).
Zone contact uses 'pad centre inside fill polygon'; thermal-relief pads on real boards may show false ratsnest lines (residual L3, design line 344).
Native CLI is slow on large boards (interpreter).
supportedEdgeCases: KiCad 5 module/fp_text syntax, coded nets, and angle-based gr_arc/fp_arc converted to three-point arcs in one helper.
KiCad 8+ property Reference/Value, (hide yes) and bare hide atoms; layer user names mapped to canonical names.
Pad shapes circle, rect, oval, roundrect, trapezoid, custom with gr_poly primitives; oval drill slots and drill offsets; np_thru_hole to -NPTH.DRL.
Arc tracks: follow by sagitta rule when one end moves; Gerber arc direction checked by read-back.
Footprint moved together with its selected tracks (no double move); absolute drag targets (no accumulating delta).
Hidden elements ignored by connectivity, ratsnest and export; pads with net '' never join.

Skipped kinds (dimension, target, image, gr_text_box, gr_bbox, model, group) warned with counts; group members still read; keepout/rule_area zones skipped with kicad.ruleArea; pts arcs flattened with kicad.polygonArc.
20,000-segment parse and 5,000-track connectivity without quadratic blowup.
PCB tools on non-pcb pages create nothing; a single Track click creates nothing until Enter or double click.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Thermal-relief spoke analysis in zone contact (residual L3).
Verification of angle, mirroring and KiCad 5 arc-sign assumptions against real KiCad output (self-authored fixtures only).
Legacy PCBNEW-BOARD files (refused with kicad.legacyFormat); versions below 20171130 read with a warning only.
Bit-exact native parity for rotations that are not multiples of 45 degrees.
